# Phone HEIC fixture

`portrait-arrow.heic` is a real iPhone 8 Plus portrait photo: a 4032x3024 grid
of 512 tiles with a rotation box of -90, shown as 3024x4032. It holds an
upright arrow, so a wrong turn is obvious.

It is `tests/images/heif_other/arrow.heic` from the pillow_heif project, under
the BSD-3-Clause licence in `LICENSE-pillow_heif.txt`, which must travel with it.
